observations.body: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: The seer is carried in the Spirit into a wilderness and shown a woman on a beast.
observations.label: A place to see judgment

observations.body: The Spirit carries the seer into a wilderness where the woman, beast, cup, and written name are shown.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Revelation 17:1–5 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The vision supplies dense signs while marking part of their identity as mystery.
payload.title: Carried away to see
